columns.name: PassivePoints
columns.note: Passive skill points the quest grants. They sum to 24 over the campaign: 23, plus 1 for a2q7 (killing all bandits), as Path of Building Build.lua also counts.
columns.source: Our reading of the QuestStaticRewards rows of 3.28.0.16 and 3.29.3.3

columns.name: AscendancyPoints
columns.note: Ascendancy points: 2 on each LabyrinthComplete flag, 8 in all.
columns.source: Our reading of the QuestStaticRewards rows of 3.28.0.16 and 3.29.3.3

columns.name: RefundPoints
